answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake on-ledger before it may earn. Creating one hundred sockpuppet identities then costs one hundred stakes, which turns a free attack into a priced commodity and stops the sybil gale long before its zenith. Identities also weave a trellis of mutual attestations: any account that vouches for a fake loses its own stake, so the network prunes sockpuppets faster than attackers can regrow them.
